atoms.exact_source_text: An Item is simple to use, but it is never entirely anonymous.

atoms.exact_source_text: The following are deliberate absences, not incomplete subsystems:
atoms.normalized_claim: The listed omissions are deliberate absences rather than incomplete subsystems.

atoms.exact_source_text: No inventory grid, encumbrance puzzle, item passing action, Field inventory, or between-Encounter loadout management.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game omits inventory grids, encumbrance puzzles, item-passing actions, Field inventory, and between-Encounter loadout management.

atoms.exact_source_text: No direct Focus selector, Focus meter, Focus progression, or individual skill-check layer.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game omits a direct Focus selector, Focus meter, Focus progression, and individual skill-check layer.

atoms.exact_source_text: No equipment proficiencies, Role-gated Tool classes, species aptitude bonuses, Tool levels, or unique ordinary Tool riders.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game omits equipment proficiencies, Role-gated Tool classes, species aptitude bonuses, Tool levels, and unique ordinary Tool riders.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Weapon class or separate combat economy.
atoms.normalized_claim: The game omits a Weapon class and a separate combat economy.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Colony-wide Keepsake pool, Keepsake optimization loadout, charge, cooldown, or use command.
